problems.reason: Sentence 7 states fossils were found in eastern Utah, while sentence 9 claims fossils come from western Utah and Texas.
Both sentences assert that Cedarosaurus belongs to the family Brachiosauridae.
The sentences describe characteristics and classification of the family Brachiosauridae as if they were attributes of Cedarosaurus itself.

Sentences 7 and 9 give conflicting locations for Cedarosaurus fossils: 7 states eastern Utah (Yellow Cat Member of Cedar Mountain Formation) while 9 states western Utah (Yellow Cat Member of Cedar Formation) and Texas.
